1.1: Or learbaa asar, bodkin et hechametz leor hanner. kol makom sheen machnisin bo chametz en tzarich bedika. velama amru shete shurot bammartef, makom shemmachnisin bo chametz. bet shammay omrim, shete shurot al pene chol hammartef. uvet hillel omrim, shete shurot hachitzonot shehen haelyonot:
1.2: En choshshin shemma garra chulda mibbayit levayit umimmakom lemakom, deim ken, mechatzer lechatzer umeir leir, en laddavar sof:
1.3: Rabbi yehuda omer, bodkin or arbaa asar uvearbaa asar shacharit uvishat habbiur. vachachamim omrim, lo vadak or arbaa asar, yivdok bearbaa asar. lo vadak bearbaa asar, yivdok betoch hammoed. lo vadak betoch hammoed, yivdok leachar hammoed. uma shemmeshayyer, yannichennu vetzina, kede shello yehe tzarich bedika acharav:
1.4: Rabbi meir omer, ochlin kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh. verabbi yehuda omer, ochlin kol arba, vetolin kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh:
1.5: Veod amar rabbi yehuda, shete challot shel toda fesulot munnachot al gag haitztabba. kol zeman shemmunnachot, kol haam ochlim. nittela achat, tolin, lo ochlin velo sorfin. nittelu shetehen, hitchilu chol haam sorfin. rabban gamliel omer, chullin neechalin kol arba, uteruma kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh:
1.6: Rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millisrof et habbasar shennitma vivlad hattuma im habbasar shennitma veav hattuma, af al pi shemmosifin tuma al tumato. hosif rabbi akiva veamar, mimehem shel kohanim lo nimneu millehadlik et hashshemen shennifsal bitvul yom bener shennitma vitme met, af al pi shemmosifin tuma al tumato:
1.7: Amar rabbi meir, middivrehem lamadnu, shessorfin teruma tehora im hattemea befesach. amar lo rabbi yose, enah hi hammidda. umodim rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua, shessorfin zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah. al ma nechelku, al hatteluya veal hattemea, sherabbi eliezer omer, tissaref zo leatzmah vezo leatzmah, verabbi yehoshua omer, shetehen keechat:

2.1: Kol shaa shemmuttar leechol, maachil labbehema lachayya velaofot, umochro lannachri, umuttar bahanaato. avar zemanno, asur bahanaato, velo yassik bo tannur vechirayim. rabbi yehuda omer, en biur chametz ella serefa. vachachamim omrim, af mefarer vezore laruach o mattil layyam:
2.2: Chametz shel nachri sheavar alav happesach, muttar bahanaa. veshel yisrael, asur bahanaa. shenneemar (Shemot 13) lo yerae lecha seor:
2.3: Nachri shehilva et yisrael al chametzo, achar happesach muttar bahanaa. veyisrael shehilva et hannachri al chametzo, achar happesach asur bahanaa. chametz shennafla alav mappolet, hare hu chimvoar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kol sheen hakkelev yachol lechappes acharav:
2.4: Haochel terumat chametz befesach beshogeg, meshallem keren vechomesh. bemezid, patur mittashlumim umiddeme etzim:
2.5: Ellu devarim sheadam yotze vahen yede chovato befesach, bechittim, bisorim, bechussemin uveshifon uveshibbolet shual. veyotzin bidmay uvemaaser rishon shennittela terumato, uvemaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, vehakkohanim bechalla uvitruma. aval lo vetevel, velo vemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, velo vemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu. challot toda urekike nazir, asaan leatzmo, en yotzin bahen. asaan limkor bashshuk, yotzin bahen:
2.6: Veellu yerakot sheadam yotze vahen yede chovato befesach, bachazeret uveulashin uvetamcha uvecharchavina uvemaror. yotzin bahen ben lachin ben yeveshin, aval lo chevushin velo shelukin velo mevushshalin. umitztarfin lechazzayit. veyotzin bakkelach shellahen, uvidmay, uvemaaser rishon shennittela terumato, uvemaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu:
2.7: En shorin et hammursan lattarnegolim, aval choltin. haishsha lo tishre et hammursan shettolich beyadah lammerchatz, aval shafa hi bivsarah yavesh. lo yilos adam chittin veyanniach al makkato befesach, mippene shehen machamitzot:
2.8: En notnin kemach letoch hacharoset o letoch hachardal, veim natan, yochal miyyad, verabbi meir oser. en mevashshelin et happesach lo vemashkin velo veme ferot, aval sachin umatbilin oto vahen. me tashmisho shel nachtom, yishshafchu, mippene shehen machamitzin:

3.1: Ellu ovrin befesach, kuttach habbavli, veshechar hammadi, vechometz haadomi, vezetom hammitzri, vezoman shel tzabbaim, vaamilan shel tabbachim, vekolan shel sofrim. rabbi eliezer omer, af tachshite nashim. ze hakkelal, kol shehu mimmin dagan, hare ze over befesach. hare ellu veazhara, veen bahen mishshum karet:
3.2: Batzek shebbesidke areva, im yesh kazzayit bemakom echad, chayyav levaer. veim lo, batel bemiuto. vechen leinyan hattuma, im makpid alav, chotzetz. veim rotze vekiyyumo, hare hu chaareva. batzek hacheresh, im yesh kayyotze vo shehechemitz, hare ze asur:
3.3: Ketzad mafrishin challa vetuma veyom tov, rabbi eliezer omer, lo tikra lah shem ad shetteafe. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer, tattil betzonen. amar rabbi yehoshua, lo ze hu chametz shemmuzharim alav beval yerae uveval yimmatze, ella mafrashtah umannachta ad haerev, veim hechemitza, hechemitza:
3.4: Rabban gamliel omer, shalosh nashim lashot keachat veofot betannur echad, zo achar zo. vachachamim omrim, shalosh nashim oskot babbatzek, achat lasha veachat orechet veachat ofa. rabbi akiva omer, lo chol hannashim velo chol haetzim velo chol hattannurim shavin. ze hakkelal, tafach, tiltosh betzonen:
3.5: Siur, yissaref, vehaochlo fatur. saduk, yissaref, vehaochlo chayyav karet. ezehu siur, kekarne chagavim. saduk, shennitarvu sedakav ze vaze, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, ze vaze, haochlo chayyav karet. veezehu siur, kol shehichsifu fanav keadam sheamdu saarotav:
3.6: Arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat, mevaarim et hakkol millifne hashshabbat, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bizmannan. rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer, teruma millifne hashshabbat, vechullin bizmannan:
3.7: Haholech lishchot et pischo, velamul et beno, veleechol seuddat erusin bevet chamiv, venizkar sheyyesh lo chametz betoch beto, im yachol lachazor ulevaer velachazor lemitzvato, yachazor vivaer. veim lav, mevattelo velibbo. lehatztzil min hannachrim, umin hannahar, umin hallistim, umin haddeleka, umin hammappolet, yevattel belibbo. velishbot shevitat harshut, yachazor miyyad:
3.8: Vechen mi sheyyatza mirushalayim venizkar sheyyesh beyado besar kodesh, im avar tzofim, sorfo vimkomo. veim lav, chozer vesorfo lifne habbira meatze hammaaracha. vead kamma hen chozrin, rabbi meir omer, ze vaze vechabbetza. rabbi yehuda omer, ze vaze vechazzayit. vachachamim omrim, besar kodesh bechazzayit, vechametz bechabbetza:

4.1: Makom shennahagu laasot melacha bearve fesachim ad chatzot, osin. makom shennahagu shello laasot, en osin. haholech mimmakom sheosin lemakom sheen osin, o mimmakom sheen osin lemakom sheosin, notnin alav chumre makom sheyyatza mishsham vechumre makom shehalach lesham. veal yeshanne adam, mippene hammachaloket:
4.2: Kayyotze vo, hammolich perot sheviit mimmakom shekkalu lemakom shello chalu, o mimmakom shello chalu lemakom shekkalu, chayyav levaer. rabbi yehuda omer, omrim lo, tze vehave lecha af atta:
4.3: Makom shennahagu limkor behema dakka laggoyim, mochrin. makom shennahagu shello limkor, en mochrin. uvechol makom en mochrin lahem behema gassa, agalim useyachim shelemin ushevurin. rabbi yehuda mattir bishvura. ben betera mattir besus:
4.4: Makom shennahagu leechol tzali velele fesachim, ochlin. makom shennahagu shello leechol, en ochlin. makom shennahagu lehadelik et hanner belele yom hakkippurim, madlikin. makom shennahagu shello lehadelik, en madlikin. umadlikin bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot, uvammevoot haafelim, veal gabbe hacholim:
4.5: Makom shennahagu laasot melacha vetisha veav, osin. makom shennahagu shello laasot melacha, en osin. uvechol makom talmide chachamim betelim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, leolam yaase adam atzmo talmid chacham. vachachamim omrim, bihuda hayu osin melacha vearve fesachim ad chatzot, uvaggalil lo hayu osin kol ikkar. vehallayla, bet shammay osrin, uvet hillel mattirin ad hanetz hachamma:
4.6: Rabbi meir omer, kol melacha shehitchil bah kodem learbaa asar, gomrah bearbaa asar. aval lo yatchil bah battechilla vearbaa asar, af al pi sheyyachol legamrah. vachachamim omrim, shalosh ummanuyyot osin melacha vearve fesachim ad chatzot, veellu hen, hachayyatim, hassapparim vehakkovsin. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer, af haratzanim:
4.7: Moshivin shovachin lattarnegolim bearbaa asar. vetarnegolet shebbarcha, machazirin otah limkomah. veim meta, moshivin acheret tachteha. gorfin mittachat ragle vehema vearbaa asar, uvammoed mesallekin latztzedadin. molichin umeviin kelim mibbet haumman, af al pi sheenam letzorech hammoed:
4.8: Shishsha devarim asu anshe yericho, al shelosha michu veyadam, veal shelosha lo michu veyadam. veellu hen shello michu veyadam, markivin dekalim kol hayyom, vechorchin et shema, vekotzrin vegodshin lifne haomer, velo michu veyadam. veellu shemmichu veyadam, mattirin gimziyyot shel hekdesh, veochlin mittachat hannesharim beshabbat, venotnim pea layyarak, umichu veyadam chachamim:
4.9: Shishsha devarim asa chizkiyya hammelech, al shelosha hodu lo, veal shelosha lo hodu lo. gerar atzmot aviv al mitta shel chavalim, vehodu lo. kittet nechash hannechoshet, vehodu lo. ganaz sefer refuot, vehodu lo. al shelosha lo hodu lo, kitztzetz delatot shel hechol veshiggeran lemelech ashshur, velo hodu lo. satam me gichon haelyon, velo hodu lo. ibber nisan benisan, velo hodu lo:

5.1: Tamid nishchat bishmone umechetza vekarev betesha umechetza. bearve fesachim nishchat besheva umechetza vekarev bishmone umechetza, ben bechol ben beshabbat. chal erev pesach lihyot beerev shabbat, nishchat beshesh umechetza vekarev besheva umechetza, vehappesach acharav:
5.2: Happesach sheshshechato shello lishmo, vekibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishmo, o lishmo veshello lishmo, o shello lishmo velishmo, pasul. ketzad lishmo veshello lishmo, leshem pesach uleshem shelamim. shello lishmo velishmo, leshem shelamim uleshem pasach:
5.3: Shechato shello leochlav veshello limnuyav, laarelim velitmeim, pasul. leochlav veshello leochlav, limnuyav veshello limnuyav, lemulim velaarelim, litmeim velithorim, kasher. shechato kodem chatzot, pasul, mishshum shenneemar (Shemot 12) ben haarbayim. shechato kodem lattamid, kasher, uvilvad sheyyehe echad memares bedamo ad sheyyizzarek dam hattamid. veim nizrak, kasher:
5.4: Hashshochet et happesach al hechametz, over belo taase. rabbi yehuda omer, af hattamid. rabbi shimon omer, happesach bearbaa asar, lishmo chayyav, veshello lishmo patur. ushear kol hazzevachim, ben lishman uven shello lishman, patur. uvammoed, lishmo patur, veshello lishmo chayyav, ushear kol hazzevachim, ben lishman uven shello lishman, chayyav, chutz min hachattat sheshshechatah shello lishmah:
5.5: Happesach nishchat beshalosh kittot, shenneemar veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael, (Shemot 12) kahal veeda veyisrael. nichnesa chat harishona, nitmallet haazara, naalu daltot haazara. taku, heriu vetakau. hakkohanim omdim shurot shurot, uvidehem baziche chesef uvaziche zahav. shura shekkullah kesef kesef, veshura shekkullah zahav zahav. lo hayu meoravin. velo hayu labbazichin shulayim, shemma yannichum veyikrash haddam:
5.6: Shachat yisrael vekibbel hakkohen, notno lachavero vachavero lachavero, umekabbel et hammale umachazir et harekan. kohen hakkarov etzel hammizbeach zorko zerika achat keneged hayesod:
5.7: Yatzta chat rishona venichnesa chat sheniyya. yatzta sheniyya, nichnesa shelishit. kemaase harishona kach maase hashsheniyya vehashshelishit. karu et hahallel. im gamru shanu, veim shanu shilleshu, af al pi shello shilleshu mimehem. rabbi yehuda omer, mimehem shel kat shelishit lo higgia leahavti ki yishma Adonai, mippene sheammah muatin:
5.8: Kemaasehu vechol kach maasehu veshabbat, ella shehakkohanim medichim et haazara shello virtzon chachamim. rabbi yehuda omer, kos haya memalle middam hattaarovot, zerako zerika achat al gabbe hammizbeach, velo hodu lo chachamim:
5.9: Ketzad tolin umafshitin, unkelayot shel barzel hayu kevuim bakketalim uvaammudim, shebbahen tolin umafshitin. vechol mi sheen lo makom litlot ulehafshit, maklot dakkim chalakim hayu sham, umeniach al ketefo veal ketef chavero, vetole umafshit. rabbi eliezer omer, arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat, meniach yado al ketef chavero, veyad chavero al ketefo, vetole umafshit:
5.10: Kerao vehotzi emurav, netano vemagis vehiktiran al gabbe hammizbeach. yatzta chat rishona veyashva lah behar habbayit, sheniyya bachel, vehashshelishit bimkomah omedet. chashecha, yatzu vetzalu et pischehen:

6.1: Ellu devarim bappesach dochin et hashshabbat, shechitato uzerikat damo umichuy keravav vehekter chalavav. aval tzeliyyato vahadachat keravav enan dochin et hashshabbat. harekavato vahavaato michutz lattechum, vachatichat yabbalto, en dochin et hashshabbat. rabbi eliezer omer, dochin:
6.2: Amar rabbi eliezer, vahalo din hu, ma im shechita shehi mishshum melacha docha et hashshabbat, ellu shehen mishshum shevut lo yidchu et hashshabbat. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, yom tov yochiach, shehittiru vo mishshum melacha, veasur bo mishshum shevut. amar lo rabbi eliezer, ma ze, yehoshua, ma reaya reshut lemitzva. heshiv rabbi akiva veamar, hazzaa tochiach, shehi mitzva vehi mishshum shevut veenah docha et hashshabbat, af atta al titma al ellu, sheaf al pi shehen mitzva vehen mishshum shevut, lo yidchu et hashshabbat. amar lo rabbi eliezer, vealeha ani dan, uma im shechita shehi mishshum melacha, docha et hashshabbat, hazzaa shehi mishshum shevut, eno din sheddocha et hashshabbat. amar lo rabbi akiva, o chilluf, ma im hazzaa shehi mishshum shevut, enah docha et hashshabbat, shechita shehi mishshum melacha, eno din shello tidche et hashshabbat. amar lo rabbi eliezer, akiva, akarta ma shekkatuv battora, ben haarbayim bemoado (Bamidbar 9), ben bechol ben beshabbat. amar lo, rabbi, have li moed laellu kammoed lashshechita. kelal amar rabbi akiva, kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat, enah docha et hashshabbat. shechita shei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat, docha et hashshabbat:
6.3: Ematay mevi chagiga immo, bizman shehu va bechol, betohora uvemuat. uvizman shehu va beshabbat, bimrubbe uvetuma, en meviin immo chagiga:
6.4: Chagiga hayta vaa min hatztzon, min habbakar, min hakkevasim umin haizzim, min hazzecharim umin hannekevot. veneechelet lishne yamim velayla echad:
6.5: Happesach sheshshechato shello lishmo veshabbat, chayyav alav chattat. ushear kol hazzevachim sheshshechatan leshum pesach, im enan reuyin, chayyav. veim reuyin hen, rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter. amar rabbi eliezer, ma im happesach shehu muttar lishmo, kesheshshinna et shemo, chayyav, zevachim shehen asurin lishman, kesheshshinna et sheman, eno din sheyyehe chayyav. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, lo, im amarta bappesach, sheshshinnahu ledavar asur, tomar bazzevachim, sheshshinnan ledavar hammuttar. amar lo rabbi eliezer, emure tzibbur yochichu, shehen muttarin lishman, vehashshochet lishman, chayyav. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, lo, im amarta veemure tzibbur sheyyesh lahen kitzba, tomar bappesach sheen lo kitzba. rabbi meir omer, af hashshochet leshem emure tzibbur, patur:
6.6: Shechato shello leochlav veshello limnuyav, laarelin velitmein, chayyav. leochlav veshello leochlav, limnuyav veshello limnuyav, lemulin velaarelin, lithorim velitmeim, patur. shechato venimtza vaal mum, chayyav. shechato venimtza terefa vasseter, patur. shechato venoda shemmashchu habbealim et yadam, o shemmetu o shennitmeu, patur, mippene sheshshachat birshut:

7.1: Ketzad tzolin et happesach, meviin shappud shel rimmon, tochavo mittoch piv ad bet nekuvato, venoten et keraav veet bene meav letocho, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer, kemin bishshul hu ze, ella tolin chutza lo:
7.2: En tzolin et happesach lo al hashshappud velo al haaskela. amar rabbi tzadok, maase berabban gamliel sheamar letavi avdo, tze utzele lanu et happesach al haaskela. naga becharso shel tannur, yiklof et mekomo. nataf meratbo al hacheres vechazar alav, yittol et mekomo. nataf meratbo al hassolet, yikmotz et mekomo:
7.3: Sacho veshemen teruma, im chavurat kohanim, yochelu. im yisrael, im chay hu, yedichennu. veim tzali hu, yiklof et hachitzon. sacho veshemen shel maaser sheni, lo yaasennu damim al bene chavura, sheen podin maaser sheni virushalayim:
7.4: Chamishsha devarim bain betuma veenan neechalin betuma. haomer, ushete hallechem, velechem happanim, vezivche shalme tzibbur, useire rashe chodashim. happesach shebba vetuma, neechol betuma, shello va mittechillato ella laachila:
7.5: Nitma habbasar vehachelev kayyam, eno zorek et haddam. nitma hachelev vehabbasar kayyam, zorek et haddam. uvammukdashin eno chen, ella af al pi shennitma habbasar vehachelev kayyam, zorek et haddam:
7.6: Nitma kahal o rubbo, o shehayu hakkohanim temeim vehakkahal tehorim, yease vetuma. nitma miut hakkahal, hattehorin osin et harishon, vehattemein osin et hashsheni:
7.7: Happesach shennizrak damo, veachar kach noda shehu tame, hatztzitz meratztze. nitma hagguf, en hatztzitz meratztze, mippene sheamru, hannazir veose fesach, hatztzitz meratztze al tumat haddam, veen hatztzitz meratztze al tumat hagguf. nitma tumat hattehom, hatztzitz meratztze:
7.8: Nitma shalem o rubbo, sorfin oto lifne habbira meatze hammaaracha. nitma miuto, vehannotar, sorfin oto vechatzrotehen o al gaggotehen meatze atzman. hatztzaykanin sorfin oto lifne habbira, bishvil lehanot meatze hammaaracha:
7.9: Happesach sheyyatza o shennitma, yissaref miyyad. nitmeu habbealim o shemmetu, teubbar tzurato veyissaref beshishsha asar. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, af ze yissaref miyyad, lefi sheen lo ochlin:
7.10: Haatzamot, vehaggidin, vehannotar, yissarfu veshishsha asar. chal shishsha asar lihyot beshabbat, yissarfu beshiva asar, lefi sheenan dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov:
7.11: Kol hanneechol beshor haggadol, yeachel bigdi harach, verashe chenafayim vehassechusim. hashshover et haetzem bappesach hattahor, hare ze loke arbaim. aval hammotir battahor vehashshover battame, eno loke et haarbaim:
7.12: Evar sheyyatza miktzato, chotech ad shemmaggia laetzem, vekolef ad shemmaggia lapperek, vechotech. uvammukdashin kotzetz bakkofitz, sheen bo mishshum shevirat haetzem. min haagaf velifnim kelifnim, min haagaf velachutz kelachutz. hachallonot veovi hachoma, kelifnim:
7.13: Shete chavurot shehayu ochlot bevayit echad, ellu hofchin et penehem helach veochlin, veellu hofchin et penehem helach veochlin, vehammecham baemtza. ucheshehashshammash omed limzog, kofetz et piv umachazir et panav ad shemmaggia etzel chavurato veochel. vehakkalla, hofechet paneha veochelet:

8.1: Haishsha bizman shehi bevet balah, shachat aleha balah veshachat aleha aviha, tochal mishshel balah. halcha regel rishon laasot bevet aviha, shachat aleha aviha veshachat aleha balah, tochal bimkom shehi rotza. yatom sheshshachatu alav appotroppesin, yochal bimkom shehu rotze. eved shel shene shuttafin, lo yochal mishshel shenehen. mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ven chorin, lo yochal mishshel rabbo:
8.2: Haomer leavdo, tze ushechot alay et happesach, shachat gedi, yochal. shachat tale, yochal. shachat gedi vetale, yochal min harishon. shachach ma amar lo rabbo, ketzad yaase, yishchat tale ugedi veyomar, im gedi amar li rabbi, gedi shello vetale shelli. veim tale amar li rabbi, hattale shello ugedi shelli. shachach rabbo ma amar lo, shenehem yetzu levet hasserefa, ufeturin millaasot pesach sheni:
8.3: Haomer levanav, hareni shochet et happesach al mi sheyyaale mikkem rishon lirushalayim, kevan shehichnis harishon rosho verubbo, zacha vechelko umezakke et echav immo. leolam nimnin alav ad sheyyehe vo chazzayit lechol echad veechad. nimnin umoshchin et yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet. rabbi shimon omer, ad sheyyizrok alav et haddam:
8.4: Hammamne immo acherim bechelko, rashshain bene chavura litten lo et shello, vehu ochel mishshello, vehen ochlin mishshellahen:
8.5: Zav sheraa shete reiyyot, shochatin alav bashshevii. raa shalosh, shochatin alav bashshemini shello. shomeret yom keneged yom, shochatin aleha vashsheni shellah. raata shene yamim, shochatin aleha vashshelishi. vehazzava, shochatin aleha vashshemini:
8.6: Haonen, vehamefakkeach et haggal, vechen mi shehivtichuhu lehotzio mibbet haasurim, vehachole vehazzaken shehen yecholin leechol kazzayit, shochatin alehen. al kullan en shochatin alehen bifne atzman, shemma yaviu et happesach lide fesul. lefichach im era bahen pesul, peturin millaasot pesach sheni, chutz min hamefakkeach baggal, shehu tame mittechillato:
8.7: En shochatin et happesach al hayyachid, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi yose mattir. afillu chavura shel mea sheen yecholin leechol kazzayit, en shochatin alehen. veen osin chavurat nashim vaavadim uketannim:
8.8: Onen tovel veochel et pischo laerev, aval lo vakkadashim. hashshomea al meto, vehamelakket lo atzamot, tovel veochel bakkadashim. ger shennitgayyer beerev pesach, bet shammay omrim, tovel veochel et pischo laerev. uvet hillel omrim, happoresh min haarla keforesh min hakkaver:

9.1: Mi shehaya tame o vederech rechoka velo asa et harishon, yaase et hashsheni. shagag o neenas velo asa et harishon, yaase et hashsheni. im ken, lamma neemar tame o shehaya vederech rechoka, sheellu peturin mehikkaret, veellu chayyavin behikkaret:
9.2: Ezo hi derech rechoka, min hammodiim velachutz, uchemiddatah lechol ruach, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer, measkuppat haazara velachutz. amar rabbi yose, lefichach nakud al Adonai, lomar, lo mippene sherchoka vadday, ella meiskuppat haazara velachutz:
9.3: Ma ben pesach rishon lashsheni, harishon asur beval yerae uval yimmatze, vehashsheni, matztza vechametz immo babbayit. harishon taun hallel baachilato, vehashsheni eno taun hallel baachilato. ze vaze taun hallel baasiyyatan, veneechalin tzali al matztzot umerorim, vedochin et hashshabbat:
9.4: Happesach shebba vetuma, lo yochlu mimmennu zavin vezavot niddot veyoldot. veim achlu, peturim mikkaret. rabbi eliezer poter af al biat mikdash:
9.5: Ma ben pesach mitzrayim lefesach dorot, pesach mitzrayim mikkacho mibbeasor, vetaun hazzaa vaaguddat ezov al hammashkof veal shete mezuzot, veneechol bechippazon belayla echad, ufesach dorot noheg kol shiva:
9.6: Amar rabbi yehoshua, shamati shettemurat happesach kereva, utemurat happesach enah kereva, veen li lefaresh. amar rabbi akiva, ani afaresh. happesach shennimtza kodem shechitat happesach, yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyikkach bedamav shelamim, vechen temurato. achar shechitat happesach, karev shelamim, vechen temurato:
9.7: Hammafrish nekeva lefischo o zachar ben shete shanim, yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava. hammafrish pischo vamet, lo yeviennu veno acharav leshem pesach, ella leshem shelamim:
9.8: Happesach shennitarev bizvachim, kullan yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyavi vidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze, uvidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze, veyafsid hammotar mibbeto. nitarev bivchorot, rabbi shimon omer, im chavurat kohanim, yochelu:
9.9: Chavura sheavad pischah, veamra leechad, tze uvakkesh ushechot alenu, vehalach umatza veshachat, vehem lakchu veshachatu, im shello nishchat rishon, hu ochel mishshello, vehem ochlim immo mishshello, veim shellahen nishchat rishon, hem ochlin mishshellahen, vehu ochel mishshello. veim eno yadua eze mehen nishchat rishon, o sheshshachatu shenehen keechad, hu ochel mishshello, vehem enam ochlim immo, veshellahen yetze levet hasserefa, ufeturin millaasot pesach sheni. amar lahen, im echarti, tzeu veshachatu alay. halach umetzao, veshachat, vehen lakchu veshachatu, im shellahen nishchat rishon, hen ochlin mishshellahen, vehu ochel immahen. veim shello nishchat rishon, hu ochel mishshello, vehen ochlin mishshellahen. veim eno yadua eze mehem nishchat rishon, o sheshshachatu shenehem keechad, hen ochlin mishshellahen, vehu eno ochel immahen, veshello yetze levet hasserefa, ufatur millaasot pesach sheni. amar lahen veamru lo, ochlin kullam min harishon. veim en yadua eze mehen nishchat rishon, shenehem yotzin levet hasserefa. lo amar lahen velo amru lo, enan acharain ze laze:
9.10: Shete chavurot shennitarvu fischehen, ellu moshchin lahen echad veellu moshchin lahen echad, echad meellu va lo etzel ellu, veechad meellu va lo etzel ellu, vechach hem omrim, im shellanu hu happesach hazze, yadecha meshuchot mishshellecha venimneta al shellanu, veim shellecha hu happesach hazze, yadenu meshuchot mishshellanu venimnenu al shellach. vechen chamesh chavurot shel chamishsha chamishsha, veshel asara asara, moshchin lahen echad mikkol chavura vachavura, vechen hem omrim:
9.11: Shenayim shennitarvu fischehem, ze moshech lo echad, veze moshech lo echad, ze mamne immo echad min hashshuk, veze mamne immo echad min hashshuk, ze va etzel ze, veze va etzel ze, vechach hem omrim, im shelli hu fesach ze, yadecha meshuchot mishshellecha venimneta al shelli. veim shellecha hu fesach ze, yaday meshuchot mishshelli venimneti al shellacha:

10.1: Arve fesachim samuch lammincha, lo yochal adam ad shettechshach. vaafillu ani shebbeyisrael lo yochal ad sheyyasev. velo yifchatu lo mearba kosot shel yayin, vaafillu min hattamchuy:
10.2: Mazgu lo chos rishon, bet shammay omrim, mevarech al hayyom, veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin. uvet hillel omrim, mevarech al hayyayin, veachar kach mevarech al hayyom:
10.3: Heviu lefanav, metabbel bachazeret, ad shemmaggia lefarperet happat. heviu lefanav matztza vachazeret vacharoset ushene tavshilin, af al pi sheen charoset mitzva. rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer, mitzva. uvammikdash hayu meviim lefanav gufo shel pasach:
10.4: Mazgu lo chos sheni, vechan habben shoel aviv, veim en daat babben, aviv melammedo, ma nishtanna hallayla hazze mikkol hallelot, shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin chametz umatztza, hallayla hazze chullo matztza. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin shear yerakot, hallayla hazze maror. shebbechol hallelot anu ochlin basar tzali, shaluk, umevushshal, hallayla hazze chullo tzali. shebbechol hallelot anu matbilin paam achat, hallayla hazze shete feamim. ulefi dato shel ben, aviv melammedo. matchil bignut umesayyem beshevach, vedoresh mearammi oved avi, ad sheyyigmor kol happarasha chullah:
10.5: Rabban gamliel haya omer, kol shello amar shelosha devarim ellu befesach, lo yatza yede chovato, veellu hen, pesach, matztza, umaror. pesach, al shum sheppasach hammakom al batte avotenu vemitzrayim. matztza, al shum shennigalu avotenu vemitzrayim. maror, al shum shemmerru hammitzrim et chayye avotenu vemitzrayim. bechol dor vador chayyav adam lirot et atzmo cheillu hu yatza mimmitzrayim, shenneemar (Shemot 13), vehiggadta levincha bayyom hahu lemor, baavur ze asa Adonai li betzeti mimmitzrayim. lefichach anachnu chayyavin lehodot, lehallel, leshabbeach, lefaer, leromem, lehadder, levarech, lealle, ulekalles, lemi sheasa laavotenu velanu et kol hannissim haellu, hotzianu meavdut lecherut, miyyagon lesimcha, umeevel leyom tov, umeafela leor gadol, umishshibud ligulla. venomar lefanav, haleluyah:
10.6: Ad hechan hu omer, bet shammay omrim, ad em habbanim semecha. uvet hillel omrim, ad challamish lemayeno mayim. vechotem bigulla. rabbi tarfon omer, asher gealanu vegaal et avotenu mimmitzrayim, velo haya chotem. rabbi akiva omer, ken Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu yaggienu lemoadim velirgalim acherim habbaim likratenu leshalom, semechim bevinyan irecha vesasim baavodatecha, venochal sham min hazzevachim umin happesachim kulei, ad baruch atta Adonai gaal yisrael:
10.7: Mazgu lo chos shelishi, mevarech al mezono. revii, gomer alav et hahallel, veomer alav birkat hashshir. ben hakkosot hallalu, im rotze lishtot, yishte. ben shelishi larvii, lo yishte:
10.8: Veen maftirin achar happesach afikoman. yashnu miktzatan, yochlu. kullan, lo yochelu. rabbi yose omer, nitnamnemu, yochlu. nirdemu, lo yochelu:
10.9: Happesach achar chatzot, metamme et hayyadayim. happiggul vehannotar, metammein et hayyadayim. berach birkat happesach patar et shel zevach. berach et shel zevach, lo fatar et shel pesach, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer, lo zo foteret zo, velo zo foteret zo:
